pages.text: $(li)Right-click a Core to claim it; claiming restarts attunement.$(li)Sneak-right-click as owner to lock or unlock it. Operators can unlock any Core.$(li)Only the owner flies.

$(li)Hitting a monster or being hit by one drops you instantly and blocks flight for 30 seconds.$(li)Leaving the area, or the shrine breaking, gives a few seconds of slow falling.$(li)A redstone signal into the Core pauses the whole network.
